notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Starting game speed up. Higher damage, less required completions, buffed starting auto-cannon and increased speed of all projectiles.

Attention! 1.3.1 have a freeze problem, so if you updated to it already tehn please check for updates again, version is same but with freeze is fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Max race level upped to 12: new ships, weapons, researches, ship upgrades and bonuses
[*] New Automation: Auto finish mission (limited by % of max level all time or max level in current stargate)  
[*] Some performance optimizations    
[*] Small decrease in price for sp damage/xp/scrap/mr
[*] KP amount bound to max level per stargate reset and not current
[*] Enemies spawn closer to each other (for 6+ enemies and spawns from enemy abilities)
[*] Post Raid buffs shown in HUD
[*] Add Queue All button to Bounty Hunter Guild
[/list]
    
Previous changes that were not posted here (1.2.2 - 1.2.5):
[list]
[*] New SP upgrade: Gold in mining contract unit
[*] Move weapon mount points on player and merc ships in balanced way (l-l-r-r -> l-r-l-r)
[*] MJR marker on icon for major mods
[*] Ability to accept and queue bounty from guild page + rework it to table view
[*] 'Buy Max drinks' first buys automated drinks
[*] Shipyard upgrades are grouped
[*] Increased max level for asteroid ore amount ship upgrade from 200 to 400
[*] Fix max research level sp upgrades requirement check (with stargate open)
[*] Fix common ammo mod extraction config save
[*] Max level for wave skip chance is bound to TARL (10% per level)
[*] Fix saving of hidden state for ship upgrades
[*] A bit lighter rare color and darker epic color
[*] Add new rank quests (drinks/mercs/alien races)
[*] Increase max level for mining squad levels per interval
[*] Added ordering by rarity for armory weapons/modules and changed for ammo mods - higher rarity on top
[*] Add ship inventory sorting by type and rarity
[/list]
